name: Spálené Poříčí (Czechia)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over white, with a white triangle pointing downward in the red and a black triangle pointing upward in the white.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 17 October 1997 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
